payload.text: The fictional Orion Training Programme provides a training grant of 420 euros per participant. Applications close on 15 November 2030. Applicants must complete the Orion registration form.
The fictional Orion Training Programme holds its induction session at the Blue Cedar Centre. Participants must bring their registration confirmation. The session starts at 09:30.
The fictional Vega Gardening Programme provides a gardening grant of 175 euros per participant. Applications close on 20 February 2031. Its workshop takes place at the Silver Birch Centre.
